title: Staging level
Schematic diagram
From the AnyRail plan, as built
_min_cells_east_lead: Owner, 2026-11-13: East Lead (33-35) longer so its name and Mast 34L fit; South Yard tracks shorter (6 to 4 cells) to give the length back. Owner, 2026-11-14: Switch 13 to 15 drawn short (one cell, as T274 to T237 on the upper level); the cells go to East Lead (7 cells), which lengthens West Ext beside it.
_turnbacks: Brick-Plane turns back on the sheet, as the owner approved it (2026-11-17). With the plan 5.3c the cheapest drawing turned Main West back instead (2026-11-19), so it is pinned.
_detail_sheets: Layer 3: the station sheets `schematic detail` draws, name to switches. May overlap the stations above. South Yard covers the yard and the Barn (owner, 2026-11-14); West Yard pairs the hand map with Brick and Plane; Princess is the hand map's Shenango.
_le_shift: Layout Editor only (the sheet keeps its columns; owner, 2026-11-16): staging from Plane (switch 5) to East End's switch 33 drawn two grid columns further west, into the empty space above Scale, so West Ext and East Lead are drawn longer and Main West and Brick-Plane shorter by as much, and the panel keeps its width. An even number keeps the label layer's spots as on the sheet's grid (an odd one moved a dozen labels).
_le_labels: Layout Editor station buttons (owner, 2026-11-16): the engine house's three step along one slope, one row apart; West Yard's W-2 steps from W-1 as the engine house's buttons step, so the two follow W-2's curve up to switch 3. South Yard's track names stand on one centre x, in the middle of the yard between its ladders (name_columns), and its occupancy lamps share one x, each on its track (lamp_columns; owner, 2026-11-16; the lamps are parked with the Dispatcher System). The engine house's track names step with their tracks' west ends as EH-1 and EH-2 do, each the same distance in from its track's end (name_steps; owner, 2026-11-18: EH-3 had drifted 30 px east of that line).
_le_crossover_angle: The angle each level's crossovers (single and double) cross at on the Layout Editor cut-over candidates (owner, 2026-11-16): staging at the schematic's own diverging angle, one grid column across per row, so 45 degrees; main and upper at 45 too, double crossover included (after a round at 30). A crossover with no room for its angle is drawn as steep as it must be (the plugin logs which). The fitted viewing trials draw them as they fall.
